FluoColorQuant is an efficient colorimetric and fluorescence high-throughput detection software that provides accurate sensor data analysis through advanced image processing and machine learning algorithms.
Supports fluorescence and colorimetric analysis with 0.01% precision
Supports various detection modes including single sample, standard curve, and multi-well plate
One-click export of data and reports in multiple formats
No network connection required, protecting your data security

FluoColor is developed by the Sensor and Microsystem Laboratory at Minzu University of China for experimental analysis, quality control, and result management across colorimetric, fluorescence, microfluidic-array, and spectral detection.

The current version processes data offline on the device. Detection images, experiment projects, analysis models, and result records are stored locally by default. Data leaves the app only when the user explicitly exports or shares it.

Camera access is used to capture detection images. Photo and file access is used to import experimental images and export research results. Back up important data before uninstalling the app or clearing its storage.

No standalone privacy-policy document has been published yet. If networking, cloud synchronization, or remote analysis is added later, a formal privacy policy will be provided before those features are enabled.

FluoColor currently does not declare a public open-source license. Without explicit authorization, the source code is not represented as freely copyable, modifiable, or redistributable.\n\nThe app uses third-party components including AndroidX, Jetpack Compose, Room, CameraX, Hilt, Retrofit, OkHttp, Coil, OpenCV, PyTorch Android, Apache Commons Math, uCrop, and JLaTeXMath. Each component remains governed by its original license.
